about: The Modes tab's code-mode Examples (pinball_decryptor/plugins/stern/code_modes.py): each mode's code in this folder and the recipe its own clip, picture, music loop and calls are cut from. Times are seconds into the film (the collection's file names are in 'films'). Nothing of a film is in the app: the tab cuts these from the person's own copy with the film cutter. Measured for the showcase card, 2026-09-18; see the README beside this file.
